title: SwimLap Shared Contract
description: Single source of truth for wire-level enums, error codes, and timing constants. Backend and both clients derive their local constants from this file so the whole system agrees on names and thresholds (DRY). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the codegen story.

errorCodes.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Login id or password is incorrect.
errorCodes.AUTH_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errorCodes.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been deactivated. Contact your coordinator.
errorCodes.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your role may not perform this action.
errorCodes.NOT_OWNER: You do not have access to this record.
errorCodes.SWIM_NOT_LIVE: Laps can only be recorded once a swim is live.
errorCodes.NOT_ASSIGNED: You are not assigned to this swim.
errorCodes.OVERLAPPING_ASSIGNMENT: This timer is already assigned to an overlapping swim.
errorCodes.LAP_INVALID_TIMING: Lap rejected: timing values were not finite/plausible.
errorCodes.LAP_DUPLICATE_SEQ: A lap with this sequence number already exists (ignored idempotently).
errorCodes.ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION: That state change is not allowed.

timing.comment: All thresholds live here so they can be tuned without touching code across three repos.

reference.comment: Simulated reference generator: base lap time + small random variation. failureRate marks a configurable share of references is_valid=false (exercises the no-reference path).

clientTiming.comment: Client-only UX constants (mobile). Kept here so QA can tune without a rebuild story change.
